simple.meaning: מֵעֶה (mêʻeh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “used only in plural the intestines , or (collectively) the abdomen , figuratively, sympathy ; by implication, a vest ; by extension the stomach , the uterus (or of men, the seat of generation), the heart (figuratively).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 32 times in Genesis, Numbers, Ruth, 2 Samuel, 2 Chronicles, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 15:4. The surrounding contexts include family, family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מֵעֶה (H4578) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: מֵעֶה (mêʻeh) / H4578 is traced through Genesis 15:4, Genesis 25:23, Numbers 5:22, Ruth 1:11 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H4578. meeh [ מֵעֶה ] noun masculine Isa 16:11 only plural internal organs, inward parts (intestines, bowels), belly (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic מַעֲיָא מְעָא, , , ; Arabic ; Ethiopic ; — on form compare Lag BN 156 Ba ZMG xiii. 1888, 345 ); — plural [ מֵעִים ] construct מְעֵי Psa 71:6 3 t.; suffix מֵעַי 2Sam 16:11 9 t., מֵעָ֑י Psa 22:15 ; 40:9 ; מֵעֶיךָ Gen 15:4 6 t.; מֵעַיִךְ 25:23 ; Num 5:22 ; מֵעָיו 2Sam 20:10 5 t.; מֵעֵיהֶם Ezek 7:19 ; — 1 literally: a. אַ֫רְצָה מֵעָיו וַיִּשְׁמֹּךְ 2Sam 20:10 and he poured out his inward parts on the ground (through a wound); compare מ ׳מַחֲלֵה 2Chr 21:15 , 18 , מ ׳יָָֽצְאוּ 21:15 ; 21:19 . b. as digestive organs, but without precision, nearly = stomach , belly , Job 20:14 ; Ezek 3:3 (|| בֶּטֶן ), 7:19 (|| נֶפֶשׁ ; both with מָלֵא ), Num 5:22 ; so of fish that swallowed Jonah Jonah 2:1 ; 2:2 . 2 source of procreation: ׳מִמּ יצא אשׁר (said of offspring) Gen 15:4 (JE), 2Sam 7:12 (|| זַרְעֲךָ ), 16:11 ; מ ׳צֶאֱצָאֵי Isa 48:19 (|| id. ); מ ׳מִיצִיאֵי 2Chr 32:21 . 3 = womb , יִמָּרֵ֑דוּ מִמֵּעַיִח לְאֻמִּים שְׁנֵי Gen 25:23 (J; || בֶּטֶן ), compare Isa 49:1 (|| id. ), Psa 71:6 (|| id. ), Ruth 1:11 . 4 in General = inwards, inward part , מ בְּתוֺךְ נָמֵס ֗֗֗ ׳לִבִּי Psa 22:15 , compare מ בְּתוֺךְ ׳תּוֺרָֽתְךָ 40:9 . 5 figurative = seat of emotions: pity, Isa 16:11 (|| קֶרֶב ); of God's compassion, Jer 31:20 (|| רחם ; in both subject of verb הָמוּ ); מֵעֶיךָ הֲמוֺן Isa 63:15 (|| רַחֲמֶיךָ ); distress, Jer 4:19 (twice in verse) (|| חֳמַרְמָרוּ מֵעַי לֵב, Lam 1:20 (|| לֵב ), 2:11 (|| כָּבֵד liver ); רֻתְּחוּ מֵעַי Job 30:27 (dubious, see Bu); love, עָלָיו הָמוּ מֵעַי Song 5:4 . 6 the external belly , שֵׁן עֶשֶׁת מֵעָיו Song 5:14 .
